title: Assistant memory static contract schemas
description: Assistant memory contract shapes for AMS-052/053 and DL-138. Memory export is read-only and artifact-owner routed; Teach confirm, lock, and revoke are explicit user commands. Reply context records inclusion and independent saved rule-check outcomes. Static schema and fixture consistency only; no runtime, storage, provider, security, visual or performance claim. Teach capture/cancel/route contracts remain separate follow-up work.

export_scope.description: AMS-052: gists | teachings | all. There is no scope for a display group such as Out of date.

verification_state.description: AMS-014: exactly Unverified, Verified or Discarded. Out of date is a read-time display group (AMS-047) and is never a stored, emitted or exported value.

EvidenceRef.description: Section 3.3 and AMS-006: a structured pointer to evidence stored elsewhere. Every variant is closed, so no variant can carry a diff, log or artifact body.

MemoryGistExportEntry.description: One MemoryGist as stored (section 3.1). verification_state is the stored value, so an Unverified gist is never exported as Verified; evidence goes out as pointers only.

allOf.description: AMS-014: a gist is never Verified with empty evidence_refs, so none is exported that way.

TaughtRuleExportEntry.description: One persisted Teach record as Plans/assistant-chat-design.md section 6 names its minimum fields, plus whether the user locked it (AMS-050, DL-130).

MemoryExportRequest.description: AMS-052 and CS-085: MemoryExportRequest for cmd.chat.memory.export, the one command behind both Export actions. It is read-only: it carries no field that could verify, pin, discard or edit what it exports.

MemoryExportPayload.description: What an export hands the artifact owner, which returns the ArtifactExportResult. The scope decides which lists may hold entries.

IncludedTeachingRef.description: One taught rule at the version that was included: its Teach memory_id and the SHA-256 of the normalized_fact text the prompt builder placed.

ReplyIncludedTeachings.description: AMS-051/053: a reply usage/context fragment saves included teaching versions and rule_check_outcomes. An included rule is Followed only if its saved check passed; failed is Missed and could_not_run gives no tick (DL-116, DL-138).

TeachRevokeRequest.description: User turns off exactly one current taught rule; old versions do not reactivate (ACD-481, DL-138).

TeachRevokeResult.description: TeachRevokeResult is the typed command receipt, with refusal reason on noncommit.

TeachLockRequest.description: User locks or unlocks exactly one current taught rule (ACD-481, DL-138).

TeachLockResult.description: TeachLockResult is the typed command receipt, with refusal reason on noncommit.

TeachConfirmRequest.description: User confirms a Teach capture, choosing scope, privacy, lock state and conflict disposition (ACD-477/481, DL-138).

TeachConfirmResult.description: TeachConfirmResult is the typed command receipt, with refusal reason on noncommit.

ArtifactExportResult.description: Read-only artifact-owner result for MemoryExportRequest; scope is echoed for the Memory or taught-rules Export action (AMS-052, DL-138).

RuleCheckOutcome.description: Saved outcome for one included taught-rule version on one completed reply (AMS-053, DL-138).
